name: 29322 · Campobello, SC
findings: ZIP 29322 (Campobello) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29322 (Campobello) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29322 (Campobello) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
